content_text:
Hi Master Roger,
I hope you’re doing well. I was wondering if you have seen Todd Field’s TÁR shot by Florian Hoffmeister. I was really blown away by it and there are quite a few impressive shots (especially the Julliard scene) to say the least. Curious about what you thought about the movie (cinematography and/or overall)! Thank you so much!
